description: Reviews Agent Gauntlet CLI commands that run a checkout journey against a site with `--i-have-permission` or overwrite an existing journey file with `init --force`. Help, demo, report, version and plain init runs stay automatic.
name: Agent Gauntlet command protection
saferAlternatives: Use `agent-gauntlet demo` to try the tool against built-in localhost fixture shops.
Only pass `--i-have-permission` for sites you own or have written permission to test.
